text: `MetricCard variant="outlined"` draws the tile at rest on the page: its border and `elevation/flat`, no shadow. For a surface where every card beside it is outlined, such as a dashboard of outlined chart cards, so one row of floating tiles does not read as a different kind of thing. `ChartCard variant="outlined"` now binds `elevation/flat` too, rather than `box-shadow: none`. The default, the raised tile, is unchanged.
